title: Associative source identity reservation and planning
scope: Reserve source-format-selected associative object identities in the DXF writer before generated allocation. Carry identity or fixed-collision replacement mappings into the writer's source handle remap table. No associative record is newly routed through document output by this slice.

implementationEvidence.result: fileExport selects dwgAssociativeObjects for DWG sources and associativeObjects for DXF sources, reserves each source handle before the fixed-collision planner or generated records can allocate, and adds an explicit source-to-planned mapping. Fixed DXF structural collisions receive an allocated replacement; noncolliding source handles retain their identity. Existing whole-graph strict refusal remains in place.
implementationEvidence.regression: From-scratch in-memory DWG-origin data exports and reads back a generated LINE baseline. Repeating with an associative source handle equal to that generated LINE handle causes the LINE to receive a different handle. A fixed structural source handle also reserves its remapped output identity before LINE allocation.
implementationEvidence.fixturePolicy: Generated in-memory records only. No DWG/DXF fixtures added to the repository.

results.focusedCTest: PASS 3/3: associative source-handle inventory, generated-identity reservation/remap, and existing strict DXF associative loss gate.
results.documentOutput: Associative records are not serialized by this slice; this proof establishes allocator isolation and planned identities only.

planImpact.completedScopeRemovedFromQueue: Associative source handles are reserved before generated allocation and receive explicit identity or fixed-collision source-to-planned mappings.
planImpact.remainingP4Scope: Route admitted associative encoders through the graph planner; bind emitted record handles; remap all source references; close the required descendant graph; independently inspect and read back staged output; verify whole-operation publication and retry.

nonGoals: Do not claim associative graph output from identity planning.
Do not permit partial required graphs or weaken strict output refusal.
Do not infer unsupported record fields, owner edges, or semantic behavior.
Do not claim LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, native platform, ABI, or release qualification.
